$comment: R42 C2: ran the dated-pad cell (H7xF9) under panel-R36. 12 pad streams, 0 crossers (best 5.003 vs bar 16.94) -> measured negative. New row + patch the inconclusive verification row.

new_rows.control_detail: Standing free-null bar of record (bars_v3 'free', the measured 12-register null; R34/R37 I1 plant-recover calibration). The pad artefacts (R17 P1/P2) are present and byte-exact (MANIFEST.json shas).
new_rows.hypothesis: A dated public pad (Bitcoin block hash/merkle/nonce/time, NIST beacon, or random.org pre-generated bytes) is the LP2 one-time pad.
new_rows.result: NEGATIVE. 12 pad byte streams (P1 hash/merkle/nonce/time + 2013 variants; P2 beacon output/seed + random.org aggregates) applied as additive mod-29 pads over 55 unsolved pages, ~150 stride-sampled offsets x 2 signs x 2 atbash, adjudicated under panel-R36. Global best pmax 5.003 (hash_internal_2013.bin, page 46, L=270, start 1,664,190, sign-1 atb0, reg LP1_REAL) vs free bar of record 16.94 at N=7,200; 0 crossers, no near-miss. Consistent with the doublet exclusion of additive full-entropy keystreams.
new_rows.coverage: 12 dated-pad streams, additive mod-29, ~150 offsets each (4 MB prefix), both signs, atbash, over all 55 unsolved pages; panel-max over 12 registers.
new_rows.threshold: bars_v3.bar_v3(N=7200, L in {120,240,400} nearest-and-conservative, 'free'); crosses iff non-degenerate grid-max >= bar.

three_conditionals.key_space: R17 P1 (Bitcoin hash/merkle/nonce/time) + P2 (NIST beacon, random.org) dated-pad byte streams as additive mod-29 pads, offset-swept (4 MB prefix per pad)
three_conditionals.adjudicator_register: panel-R36, panel-max over 12 registers; free-null bar of record

new_rows.not_covered: Offsets beyond the 4 MB prefix of each pad (the random.org aggregates are 65-95 MB); date->offset anchoring beyond the offset sweep; byte%29 bias (256=8*29+24); the per-day random.org files individually (only the aggregates swept); a fresh per-shuffle null.
new_rows.reopens_if: the oracle flags a page; a specific date->offset anchor is hypothesised with evidence; the full pad length (beyond 4 MB) is swept.
new_rows.notes: Closes the round41-C1 'dated-pad data absent (clone-scoped)' verification; the 523 MB of P1/P2 pad data is present and the cell is a measured negative, not blocked.

patches.notes_add: R42-C2: the P1/P2 pad data (523 MB) was present all along (clone-scoped absence, X1-B B-2). Ran the dated-pad cell under panel-R36 -> measured negative (R42-C2-R36-DATED-PADS-RUN, best 5.003 vs bar 16.94).
